coupon.title: Fit test kit
hardware: 1 disc magnet (6 x 3 mm for M2, 4 x 2 mm for M1.5, 3 x 2 mm for M1) for the magnet pocket
a printed gear to try on the jaws (M2 and M1.5)
hardware_pins: 1 bolt (1-level length)
1 nut
1 bearing
1 of the dowel pins (3 x 8 mm for M2, 2 x 6 mm for M1.5 and M1) to try both pin fits
1 disc magnet (6 x 3 mm for M2, 4 x 2 mm for M1.5, 3 x 2 mm for M1) for the magnet pocket

starter.title: Starter kit
hardware: (two stacked gears join on their jaws, no hardware)
hardware_pins: 4 bolts (2-level length)
4 nuts
7 bearings
3 dowel pins (3 x 8 mm for M2, 2 x 6 mm for M1.5 and M1) to join two stacked gears

crank.title: Hand crank kit
hardware: 1 bolt as the crank post (M8 x 45 for M2, M6 x 40 for M1.5, M5 x 35 for M1) and 1 nut
(the hub ring drops over any gear's jaws)
hardware_pins: 3 short dowel pins (3 x 6 mm for M2, 2 x 4 mm for M1.5 and M1) pressed into the hub ring
1 bolt as the crank post (M8 x 45 for M2, M6 x 40 for M1.5, M5 x 35 for M1) and 1 nut
(pins onto any gear's top face)

pointer.title: Pointer and dial
hardware: (replaces the knob on that pin: its bolt is the dial bolt length, 5 mm longer in M1.5 for 3 and 4 levels and in M1 for 1 level)
(the hub ring drops over the gear's jaws)
hardware_pins: (replaces the knob on that pin)
3 short dowel pins (3 x 6 mm for M2, 2 x 4 mm for M1.5 and M1) pressed into the hub ring

ratchet.title: Ratchet kit
hardware: 3 dowel pins (3 x 8 mm for M2, 2 x 6 mm for M1.5) to join the ratchet to a gear above or below it: it is too small for the jaws
hardware_pins: 2 bolts (1-level length)
2 nuts
1 bearing
3 dowel pins (3 x 8 mm for M2, 2 x 6 mm for M1.5 and M1) to join the ratchet to a gear above or below it

hardware_pins: 1 bolt (4-level length) and 1 nut for the rocker pin

4 bearings
3 short dowel pins (3 x 6 mm for M2, 2 x 4 mm for M1.5 and M1) for the crank, 1 dowel pin for the joint cap
(the crank pins onto a gear on level 1)

rack.title: Rack and pinion
hardware: (the 20T pinion goes two rows below the rail)

nema17.title: NEMA 17 motor kit
hardware: 1 NEMA 17 stepper motor and a driver

joint.title: Joining two gears
hardware: none: the upper gear's pockets drop over the lower gear's three tapered jaws
hardware_pins: 3 dowel pins (3 x 8 mm for M2, 2 x 6 mm for M1.5 and M1); with pins + screws also 3 socket head screws (M3 x 14 for M2, M2.5 x 12 for M1.5, M2 x 10 for M1), 3 nuts and the joint ring; (turn the upper gear 60 degrees so its counterbores sit over the lower gear's nut pockets)

maggear.title: Magnetic gears
hardware: 32 neodymium disc magnets (6 x 3 mm for M2, 4 x 2 mm for M1.5, 3 x 2 mm for M1), poles alternating as the dots show
(the two gears sit four sockets apart)

magcouple.title: Magnetic face coupling
hardware: 12 neodymium disc magnets (6 x 3 mm for M2, 4 x 2 mm for M1.5, 3 x 2 mm for M1), poles alternating as the dots show
(the barrier stands still between the gears: drive one, the other follows)

hexsleeve.title: Hex sleeve stack
hardware: 2 small bearings pressed into the sleeve ends: 688 (8 x 16 x 5) for M2, 686 (6 x 13 x 5) for M1.5, 685 (5 x 11 x 5) for M1
2 standard bearings pressed into the lever, 2 for the gears on the second pin
(the hex parts slide onto the sleeve and turn together; the second pin's gears turn freely, three sockets away)

jaws.title: Straight jaw gear stack (M2 test)
hardware: 1 bolt (3-level length, M8 x 50), 1 nut, 3 bearings
(stack the gears on one pin in any order: each gear's pockets drop over the jaws of the gear below)
